html:
Question 3
?

Which of the following is equivalent to (k+2)! for any k≥0?

a
(k+2)⋅(k+1)!
b
(k+2)⋅(k+1)
c
(k+2)⋅k
d
None of the listed
e
(k+2)⋅k!
Submit
